name: Volatile Memory: Pharmakos
source:
You have nothing on paper, yet TITAN, a colossal and cryptic science corp, hires you. The dream quickly sours when the inevitable truth comes knocking.

[From [url=https://vaguelygalaxy.itch.io/volatile-memory-pharmakos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
履历表上一片空白的你，竟然被庞大而神秘的科技巨头“泰坦”公司破格录用。然而当无法逃避的真相找上门来时，这场美梦瞬间变了味。
